commit.message:
Confirm Django 6.1 support (#159)

* Confirm Django 6.1 support

* Revert change to pyproject.toml

* Fix CI Django version specifier to pin to intended minor version

The ~= specifier (e.g. ~=5.0) means >=5.0,==5.*, which installs the
latest 5.x release rather than the intended 5.0.x. Change to
>=X.Y.dev0,==X.Y.* to correctly pin each matrix entry to its minor
version while still allowing pre-releases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Add Django 6.1 framework classifier

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix tests on Django 6.1.

Blank option description was changed in Django 6.1.

* Update poetry lock file hash

* Add changelog entry

---------

Co-authored-by: Mike Fogel <mike@fogel.ca>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
